It passed preflight and the gate, and the seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged.

  P1/P2 findings still open:

  - the prices are coloured by affordability

  I stopped here because those need a layout redesign, not a guide change.

The change is logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`. The before and after shop pictures are in `notes/shots/04-r4-before` and `notes/shots/04-r4-after`. I did not re-run the critic on settings or the stash this run.
